```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xc43b8.m1_top_zips AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         fare_amount,
         tpep_pickup_datetime
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
),
zip_agg AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         COUNT(*) AS trips,
         ROUND(SUM(fare_amount), 2) AS total_fare
  FROM base
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
busiest AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY pickup_zip
           ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM base
  GROUP BY pickup_zip, HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime)
),
busiest_hour AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip, hour AS busiest_hour
  FROM busiest
  WHERE rn = 1
),
joined AS (
  SELECT z.pickup_zip,
         z.trips,
         z.total_fare,
         bh.busiest_hour
  FROM zip_agg z
  LEFT JOIN busiest_hour bh ON z.pickup_zip = bh.pickup_zip
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank,
         ROUND(
           SUM(total_fare) OVER (
             ORDER BY total_fare DESC, pickup_zip ASC
             ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
           ) / SUM(total_fare) OVER () * 100,
           2
         ) AS cumulative_share_pct
  FROM joined
)
SELECT pickup_zip,
       trips,
       total_fare,
       fare_rank,
       cumulative_share_pct,
       busiest_hour
FROM ranked
WHERE fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fare_rank;
```
